description: Source code for the OrchardCore.Taxonomies module, specifically the TaxonomyFieldDisplayDriver class which manages display and editing of taxonomy fields in OrchardCore CMS.

classes.name: TaxonomyFieldDisplayDriver
classes.description: Handles display and editing of TaxonomyField in OrchardCore CMS, including rendering display shapes and processing updates.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Creates display shape for a TaxonomyField, for detail and summary views.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Creates edit shape for a TaxonomyField, populating term entries based on current taxonomy content.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to a TaxonomyField from form submissions, validating and setting selected term IDs.
